prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_flow] Preset Companion Selection Flow: Introduces a guided preset companion selection flow on the pet choice screen, allowing users to immediately select popular pet archetypes.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Archetype", "body": "Select a ready-to-spawn desktop pet archetype to begin immediately.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Preset Companion Archetypes", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Pet Account Linkage Safety Hint: Displays a clear sign-in safeguard message reassuring users that signing into their account automatically binds and restores their pet state.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in automatically pairs your desktop pet and syncs your pet progress securely."}}
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Health Status Wait Info: Provides explicit status text on the waiting screen showing engine readiness and companion spawn initialization progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Initializing Desktop Companion Engine", "body": "Preparing graphics rendering and desktop permissions. Your pet will spawn shortly.", "hint": "Engine initialization in progress. Please keep the desktop window active."}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Companion Path Selector Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a focused spotlight layout highlighting key journey choices.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Pick Your Companion Path", "body": "Select whether you want to adopt a ready pet or create a custom companion."}}
4: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Trait Customizer Flow: Adds a dedicated companion trait selection screen before final adoption certificate issuance.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_trait_picker", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_trait_picker": {"headline": "Customize Pet Personality", "body": "Choose traits that define how your pet interacts with your desktop.", "layout": "card"}}
5: [finish, redesign] Two Column Desktop Controls Guide Redesign: Redesigns the welcome screen into a two-column layout explicitly demonstrating pet quick controls and desktop interaction options.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Learn how to summon, control, and customize your pet's desktop presence."}}
6: [sign_in, redesign] Split Screen Sign In Protection Layout Redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split-screen layout detailing account protection and pet data preservation.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Sign In to Protect Your Companion", "body": "Your companion data and customization are automatically linked to your account."}}
7: [choose_path, reorder] Story Intro and Path Choice Sequence Shift: Reorders the journey so users choose their onboarding path prior to viewing the interactive story introduction.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Quick Controls Clarity Update: Updates copy on the final welcome screen to provide clear step-by-step instructions on controlling, hiding, and talking to the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, access settings, or start a conversation. Double-click to bring them to the front."}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop Companion Initialization Ready Alert Switch: Enables system notifications when the desktop engine finishes loading, notifying users as soon as their pet spawns.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}

verdicts.reason: Valid redesign of the pet choice screen maintaining the selection functionality.
Valid informational hint added to sign-in screen without violating fair design or data rules.
Valid update to waiting screen status information showing pet initialization progress.
Valid redesign of path choice screen retaining both adoption and customization options.
Valid addition of a new trait picker screen inside onboarding flow.
Valid layout redesign of home_intro screen within onboarding bounds.
Valid layout redesign of sign-in screen explaining account protection.
Valid reordering of onboarding steps without removing or skipping required steps.
Valid clarity update to copy on home_intro screen.
Valid addition of notification toggle on waiting screen while pet is being made.
